description: Check whether the first usage signal (kind events) or cost (kind costs) from the agent the setup provisioned has arrived since it was provisioned; the first time it has, the time is saved on the setup. Until the one click setup has run, the answer says nothing is provisioned yet. The one click setup that creates the agent, customer and API key is not offered here: it mints a key, so it takes a person signed in to the dashboard (/event-tracking or /cost-tracing). Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

kind.description: events for usage signals (/event-tracking), costs for cost tracing (/cost-tracing).

name: verify_instrumentation_setup
